name: Wild-Lake
description: Wild-Lake is a Talent Engineering & Structural Design studio for world-class creators. We develop artists and build the infrastructure around their work, identity, and long-term vision.

itemOffered.name: Existential mechanics
itemOffered.description: By existential mechanics, we mean examining how an artist’s identity, values, habits, relationships, and working conditions shape their creative choices. We identify what supports the work, where friction comes from, and which structures need to change, then build practical ways of working that fit the person.

itemOffered.name: A&R venture
itemOffered.description: Our A&R venture is our talent-scouting and creative-development practice. A&R stands for artists and repertoire. We find creators and work with them on the material itself: songs, plays, pilots, novels, and emerging bodies of work. We help shape ideas, select and refine material, and develop a coherent artistic direction through sustained collaboration.

itemOffered.name: Infrastructure for independence
itemOffered.description: We build the systems, workflows, and working structures around the artist so the practice can endure without giving away ownership.

itemOffered.name: Mentorship for artists
itemOffered.description: Bring your creative work and the life around it. Explore long term creative and personal support through embodied practice, sustained attention, and room for becoming.

itemOffered.name: Confidence coaching
itemOffered.description: Practice building self trust through body based awareness and clear boundaries. Begin with what you notice, what you need, and the choices available to you.

itemOffered.name: Self love coaching
itemOffered.description: Explore practical repair and congruence between your choices and your values. Practice learning to inhabit your body, not operate it.

disambiguatingDescription: Wild-Lake is not WME (William Morris Endeavor), CAA (Creative Artists Agency), or UTA (United Talent Agency), and is not affiliated with those agencies. Wild-Lake is an independent Talent Engineering & Structural Design studio. We scout talent and develop the work itself, including songs, plays, pilots, and novels, through a non-extractive, retainer-based practice that preserves artist ownership and creative control.
